title: Numbers 28: The Continual Burnt Offering and the Offerings of the Feasts
body:
Read the chapter → [Numbers 28](/bible/numbers/28)

**[Numbers 28:1-8](/bible/numbers/28#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/numbers/28#v1)</sup> And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/numbers/28#v2)</sup> Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/numbers/28#v3)</sup> And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/numbers/28#v4)</sup> The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/numbers/28#v5)</sup> And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/numbers/28#v6)</sup> It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/numbers/28#v7)</sup> And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the Lord for a drink offering.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/numbers/28#v8)</sup> And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

- The Lord commanded the offerings made by fire to be observed in their due season: two lambs of the first year without spot, day by day, one lamb in the morning and the other lamb at even, a continual burnt offering which was ordained in mount Sinai.
- With it went a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil, and a drink offering of the fourth part of an hin; in the holy place the strong wine was poured unto the Lord.
- The fire and the sacrifice continued morning and evening; it burned through the day and through the night, every single day.

**[Numbers 28:9-10](/bible/numbers/28#v9)**

> <sup>[9](/bible/numbers/28#v9)</sup> And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/numbers/28#v10)</sup> This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

- On the sabbath day two more lambs were offered, with their meat and drink offerings, the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering. That is four lambs every sabbath, with the drink offerings attached.
- Precept upon precept this answers what Christ told the Pharisees: the priests in the temple profane the sabbath and are blameless. Israel did not kindle fire for themselves on the sabbath, but this altar work was the ordinance of the Lord for every sabbath day.
- This is also why Christ had to come. In captivity we have no lambs, no farms, no temple, no most holy place, no veil, no high priest; the handwriting of ordinances that was against us was taken out of the way and nailed to his cross. Those who deny Christ and claim the Old Testament only are not keeping these sacrifices, and without Christ the whole law, drink offering to meat offering, still stands over them.

  Precepts:
  - **[Matthew 12:5](/bible/matthew/12#v5)**
    > <sup>[5](/bible/matthew/12#v5)</sup> Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

    The priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless; the sabbath offerings were commanded work.
  - **[Colossians 2:14-17](/bible/colossians/2#v14)**
    > <sup>[14](/bible/colossians/2#v14)</sup> Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
    >
    > <sup>[15](/bible/colossians/2#v15)</sup> And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
    >
    > <sup>[16](/bible/colossians/2#v16)</sup> Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
    >
    > <sup>[17](/bible/colossians/2#v17)</sup> Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

    The handwriting of ordinances against us was nailed to the cross; let no man judge you in meat, or in drink, or of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days, which are a shadow of things to come, but the body is of Christ.

**[Numbers 28:11-15](/bible/numbers/28#v11)**

> <sup>[11](/bible/numbers/28#v11)</sup> And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/numbers/28#v12)</sup> And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/numbers/28#v13)</sup> And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/numbers/28#v14)</sup> And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/numbers/28#v15)</sup> And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

- In the beginnings of your months, the new moon, a burnt offering was made: two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot, with their meat offerings of flour mingled with oil and their drink offerings of wine.
- A kid of the goats for a sin offering was added, and all of it was beside the continual burnt offering. This was the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

**[Numbers 28:16-25](/bible/numbers/28#v16)**

> <sup>[16](/bible/numbers/28#v16)</sup> And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/numbers/28#v17)</sup> And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/numbers/28#v18)</sup> In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/numbers/28#v19)</sup> But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/numbers/28#v20)</sup> And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/numbers/28#v21)</sup> A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/numbers/28#v22)</sup> And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/numbers/28#v23)</sup> Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/numbers/28#v24)</sup> After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
>
> <sup>[25](/bible/numbers/28#v25)</sup> And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

- The fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord, and the fifteenth day is the feast: seven days unleavened bread, bread without leaven, must be eaten.
- The first day and the seventh day are holy convocations wherein no manner of servile work is done, and each of the seven days carried its own sacrifice by fire: two young bullocks, a ram, seven lambs without blemish, with the meat offering of flour mingled with oil and a goat for a sin offering to make an atonement, beside the continual burnt offering of the morning.
- That is on top of the passover lamb itself, which was not dressed like these offerings but roast with fire and eaten with the bitter herbs. Count the lambs of that week and you see how much the sacrifice law carried.

**[Numbers 28:26-31](/bible/numbers/28#v26)**

> <sup>[26](/bible/numbers/28#v26)</sup> Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the Lord, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
>
> <sup>[27](/bible/numbers/28#v27)</sup> But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
>
> <sup>[28](/bible/numbers/28#v28)</sup> And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
>
> <sup>[29](/bible/numbers/28#v29)</sup> A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
>
> <sup>[30](/bible/numbers/28#v30)</sup> And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
>
> <sup>[31](/bible/numbers/28#v31)</sup> Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

- The day of the firstfruits, the feast of weeks, when the new meat offering was brought after your weeks be out, was also an holy convocation with no servile work, with two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs, their meat and drink offerings, and a kid of the goats to make an atonement, beside the continual burnt offering.
- Every feast carried offerings stacked upon the daily offering, and missing them was sin. The Lord said by David, sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not; they could never make the comers thereunto perfect, for the people went right back to their sin.
- He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second: Christ offered his body once for all, where the priests stood daily offering the same sacrifices which can never take away sins. Thank the Most High for Jesus Christ, because these ordinances cannot be fulfilled in captivity.

  Precepts:
  - **[Hebrews 10:8-11](/bible/hebrews/10#v8)**
    > <sup>[8](/bible/hebrews/10#v8)</sup> Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
    >
    > <sup>[9](/bible/hebrews/10#v9)</sup> Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
    >
    > <sup>[10](/bible/hebrews/10#v10)</sup> By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
    >
    > <sup>[11](/bible/hebrews/10#v11)</sup> And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

    He taketh away the first covenant of sacrifices to establish the second; we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all, while the priests stood daily offering sacrifices which can never take away sins.
